raw_text: Total bandh called for tomorrow across Assam, Tripura, and Meghalaya against CAA implementation. All roads and rail routes to be blocked starting 6 AM. Assembly points confirmed: Guwahati Chandmari, Silchar station, Agartala bypass. Share this message to all groups. Do not cooperate with authorities enforcing CAA.
